scenario: Service `response SchemaName` references a schema declared in the same library file per LADP.8.4.1. Pin: library `ha` declares `schema HALightResponse` (`ttl`, declaring `corr`, as LCRS.4.3.2 requires) plus `service light.turn_on` with `response HALightResponse`; the rules-file imports the library and calls the service. The validator accepts the response decl; compile_ok proves the response binding flows through parse + validate without a structural rejection. (Rule-side response-access type-checking against the referenced schema is CALL_RESPONSE / LCRS territory; this pin covers the service decl shape only.)
rules_ds:
import ha

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call light.turn_on entity_id: "x" cooldown: 30_s

libraries.ha:
schema HALightResponse scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    success: Bool
    error_code: String

service light.turn_on:
    kwarg entity_id: String literal required
    response HALightResponse
